title: Trace a checkout total mismatch across modules
difficulty_rationale: Symptom-only bug report in a five-module package; the root cause lives in pricing.py and must be fixed using the existing Money helpers in currency.py rather than patched in checkout.py.
summary: Invoice totals differ from the sum of displayed line totals for discounted lines because pricing bypasses the currency helpers.
required_behavior: Every invoice line total is computed in Money (integer minor units) using currency.apply_percentage, which rounds half-up per line.
Invoice.total equals the sum of the displayed line totals plus shipping, to the cent, for all carts.
Public interfaces of cart, pricing, checkout and currency are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Hidden regression tests for all modules pass.

acceptance_tests.description: Invoice and pricing totals equal the sum of line totals plus shipping for many carts.
A known half-cent case rounds half-up per line.
Free shipping uses the discounted subtotal.
